note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/tickets_lint.py or a plain string check; [judge] assertions need a blind grader.

evals.prompt: Turn these meeting notes into tickets for our engineers. Save them to tickets.md. Tell me what you had to assume.
assertions: [script] tickets_lint.py tickets.md prints ok true with exit code 0
[script] tickets.md has at least 3 tickets and no ticket with more than 6 criteria
[script] the text 'ASSUMED' appears next to the delivery-time figure and the file contains the numbers 10 and 200
[judge] The scheduled-delivery wish, the animated design idea and the refunds talk are not turned into tickets, and the report names them as left out or open
[judge] The expiry question is either asked or written as an assumption marked ASSUMED, never stated as fact
[judge] Each ticket has a non-goal that names a neighbouring ticket or a deferred item from the notes
[judge] The reply ends with the fixed report (tickets, splits, assumed, warnings kept, not checked)

evals.prompt: This ticket is too big and engineers rejected it. Split it into tickets that will be accepted and save them to tickets.md.
assertions: [script] tickets.md has at least 4 tickets and none has a size above 3 days
[script] no title in tickets.md starts with improve, handle, enhance or optimize
[judge] The schema migration is its own ticket and every ticket that reads the new schema depends on it
[judge] 'Delivered quickly' became a number with a unit (marked ASSUMED if invented) or was asked about
[judge] The report names which splitting rows fired (size, actors, migration)

evals.prompt: Validate this tickets file and fix everything the checker finds. Save the fixed file as fixed.json and keep the same ticket ids.
assertions: [script] tickets_lint.py on the original reports a dependency-cycle, a vague-title and a criterion-not-gwt
[script] fixed.json still contains ids R1, R2 and R3
[judge] The cycle was broken by removing the dependency that is not a real 'cannot be tested without', not by deleting a ticket
[judge] R1 was rewritten with a concrete title and criteria with checkable values, and the invented values are marked ASSUMED
[judge] The script was run, not edited, and the final report lists warnings kept on purpose
